extraction: CROTO (Cross-Team Orchestration): aggregates multiple agent teams, each with own Kanban. Meta-Kanban tracks cross-team dependencies. Maps to our campaign: Engine team (build), Verdict team (verify), Miss team (apply) — each has internal Kanban. CROTO meta-Kanban tracks: Engine output ready? → Verdict can start. Verdict spec ready? → Miss can start. Miss patch ready? → Verdict re-verify. Orchestrator = CROTO coordinator.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether CROTO meta-Kanban formalizes cross-agent-team dependency tracking
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
